observations: The GLB contains only the project M4, the approved Coro Solto hand mesh, and the authored curved magazine; donor meshes and donor materials are absent.
The fire peak is legible, but the dominant fingers cover the receiver and do not prove a stable pistol-grip/trigger-index relationship.
R9, R18 and R26 move with donor timing, but the support palm and the magazine are visibly separated rather than maintaining a grasp.
R18 pushes the weapon to the right edge, weakening the action silhouette and making insertion ambiguous.
ADS is centered but the rear sight/carry-handle mass and hands obstruct the sight picture.
